sources.snippet: TAU2 airline domain benchmark for evaluating conversational agents in dual-control environments where both AI agents and users interact with tools in airline customer service scenarios. Tests agent coordination, communication, and ability to guide user actions in tasks like flight booking, modifications, cancellations, and refunds.

sources.snippet: Tau2 Airline Key Evaluation Artifacts This directory is a compact GitHub backup of the raw evidence behind the headline tau2 airline results. It intentionally includes evaluation JSONL files and master logs, but excludes trained adapters, model weights, rollout-training JSONL files, vLLM server logs, caches, and virtualenvs.
